touch_controller.setting.layout.tooltip: A joystick moves by how far it is pushed; a D-pad presses the four movement keys.
touch_controller.setting.scale.tooltip: Grows or shrinks every on-screen control.
touch_controller.setting.opacity.tooltip: How solid the controls look over the world.
touch_controller.setting.deadzone.toolti: How far the stick moves before the player does.
touch_controller.setting.left_handed.too: Mirrors the controls: the stick on the right, the buttons on the left.
touch_controller.setting.sneak_toggle.to: The sneak button stays on until it is tapped again, instead of only while held.
